description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService class and related factory functions for managing media key capabilities via IPC in the Rialto server. It includes methods for client connection handling, querying supported key systems, and retrieving key system versions.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instances.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Concrete factory class implementing creation of MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService
classes.description: Service class providing media key capabilities over IPC, including client connection handling and key system queries.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a new MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleServiceFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to a MediaKeysCapabilitiesModuleService instance, given an ICdmService reference.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection, exporting the service to the client.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Responds with the list of supported key systems.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
